projects.name: fir_stream_accelerator
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog with SystemVerilog testbench and immediate assertions
projects.summary: Parameterized transposed-form FIR accelerator: 8 MAC/cycle, ~1 sample/clock, 7.88x over a scalar baseline; 1354-sample differential test, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: systolic_gemm_accelerator
projects.interface: Wishbone B4 classic bus with memory-mapped operand/result windows and completion interrupt
projects.software_layer: C firmware driver with tiled-GEMM host application
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model
projects.summary: Parameterized 8x8 INT8 output-stationary systolic GEMM tile engine with K-accumulate tiling: up to 64 MAC/cycle, 49.35x peak over a scalar baseline; 273 jobs / 17152 checked outputs, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: scan_prefix_sum_engine
projects.microarchitecture: parallel-prefix (Kogge-Stone) adder tree with cross-tile carry chaining
projects.interface: APB control plane plus descriptor-driven coalesced wide-DMA master with completion interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, software golden model, and scalar baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model
projects.summary: GPU-style parallel prefix-sum (scan) engine: 16-lane parallel-prefix tree streams one coalesced 512-bit beat/clock, 15.06 sustained words/cycle (16.0 ideal), 45.18x aggregate / 46.88x peak over a scalar baseline; 292 jobs / 257960 checked outputs, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: bitonic_sort_accelerator
projects.microarchitecture: fully-pipelined Batcher bitonic sorting network (compare-exchange lane array)
projects.interface: MMIO register file plus a coalesced wide-DMA memory master with completion interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, software golden model, and scalar baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model
projects.summary: GPU-style tiled bitonic sort engine: 10-stage / 80-cell compare-exchange network retires one 16-key (512-bit) tile per clock, 13.18 sustained keys/cycle (16.0 ideal), 105.43x aggregate / 116.20x peak over a scalar baseline; 286 jobs / 275984 checked keys, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_texture_filter_engine
projects.microarchitecture: line-buffer window with 2x2 texel gather and a fixed-point bilinear blend datapath
projects.interface: mailbox + doorbell registers with completion interrupt plus a coalesced wide memory master
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, software golden model, and scalar baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model
projects.summary: GPU-style bilinear texture-filter (image resampler): a two-row line-buffer window feeds a 2x2 texel gather and a Q16.16 bilinear blend datapath that retires one filtered pixel per clock; 0.67 sustained / 0.97 peak pixels/cycle (1.0 ideal), 22.49x aggregate / 32.35x peak over a scalar baseline; 290 jobs / 314316 output pixels / 78579 checked words, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_philox_rng_engine
projects.microarchitecture: fully-pipelined counter-based (Philox) multi-round datapath with parallel SIMD lanes
projects.interface: MMIO mailbox descriptor + doorbell with a coalesced wide masked write-only DMA master and completion interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, software golden model, and scalar baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model, anchored to the published Random123 known-answer vectors
projects.summary: GPU-style Philox-4x32-10 counter-based parallel RNG: a 4-lane SIMD array of fully-pipelined 10-round Philox cores retires one 128-bit random block per lane per clock (512 random bits/clock), 3.40 sustained / 3.71 peak draws/cycle (4.0 ideal), 441.95x aggregate / 481.76x peak over a scalar baseline; 294 jobs / 276808 checked words, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_cordic_sfu_engine
projects.microarchitecture: unified iterative CORDIC engine (circular + hyperbolic, rotation + vectoring) with parallel SIMD lanes
projects.interface: MMIO mailbox descriptor + shared submission/completion ring buffer in device memory over coalesced gather-read and scatter-write masters with completion interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, software golden model, and independent scalar CORDIC baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model (bit-exact), anchored to IEEE double libm for accuracy
projects.summary: GPU-style CORDIC Special Function Unit: a SIMD array of iterative shift-and-add CORDIC lanes evaluates sin/cos/exp/cosh/sinh/atan2/hypot/ln/sqrt (no multiplier in the iteration), dispatched from a shared ring buffer; ~9 cycles/function amortised over a 4-lane wave, 34.47x aggregate / 35.58x peak over a scalar CORDIC baseline, 1.15e-7 max abs error vs libm (~23 bits); 264 jobs / 13253 requests / 39759 checked words, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_order_book_engine
projects.microarchitecture: content-addressable price-level map (associative memory) with a log-depth parallel comparator-tree BBO reduction
projects.interface: AXI4-Stream market-data ingress plus a 32-bit MMIO control/snapshot register file with a BBO-update interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C feed-handler driver, a slot-exact golden order book, and a scalar linear-scan baseline cost model
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model (bit-exact), each stream run under randomised AXI-Stream backpressure and at full rate
projects.summary: GPU/FPGA-style CAM limit-order-book / BBO engine: a 32-level content-addressable price map does a single-cycle parallel (side,price) match + update, and two log-depth comparator trees pick best-bid (max) and best-ask (min) simultaneously, republishing the top of book 2 cycles after every message at a sustained 1 message/clock (0.939 msgs/clock incl. drain); 39.61x aggregate / 200.00x peak over a scalar linear-scan baseline; 266 streams / 8214 messages / 16428 checked BBO records, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_alpha_signal_engine
projects.domain: quantitative finance / real-time streaming trading signals (HFT)
projects.microarchitecture: deeply-pipelined fixed-point streaming datapath with a single-cycle read-modify-write per-symbol state loop and unrolled integer sqrt + divider pipelines
projects.interface: AXI4-Stream tick ingress + AXI4-Stream signal egress + AXI4-Lite control/status register file with an alert interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C feed-handler driver, a bit-exact fixed-point golden model, and a documented scalar cost-model baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model (bit-exact), each stream run under randomised ingress gaps + egress backpressure and again at full rate, plus control-plane counter/IRQ checks
projects.summary: GPU/FPGA-style real-time alpha-signal engine: per-symbol fast/slow EWMA + rolling variance in a single-cycle read-modify-write symbol RAM feed a deep feed-forward tail (32-stage integer sqrt then 48-stage divider) that emits a z-score / momentum / alert signal record every tick at a sustained 1.000 ticks/clock with a deterministic 84-cycle latency; 54.73x aggregate / 83.00x peak over a scalar baseline; 264 streams / 57959 ticks / 115918 checked records, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_bitpack_decode_engine
projects.microarchitecture: streaming bit-unpack dataflow with a variable-rate bit-FIFO aligner, a 4-lane barrel-shift field extractor, and a combinational zig-zag + 4-wide delta-prefix reconstruction tail
projects.interface: AXI4-Stream compressed ingress + wide 128-bit AXI4-Stream decoded egress + AXI4-Lite control/status register file with a block-done/error interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, a bit-exact reference codec (encoder + golden decoder), and a documented scalar cost-model baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model (bit-exact), each block streamed under randomised ingress bubbles + egress backpressure and again at full rate, plus a peak micro-benchmark and a malformed-block error/IRQ test
projects.summary: GPU/FPGA-style line-rate columnar (FOR + delta + zig-zag + bit-pack) market-data decompression engine: a 192-bit variable-rate bit-FIFO feeds a 4-lane barrel-shift field extractor and a combinational zig-zag + 4-wide delta-prefix tail that retires up to 4 decoded int32 values/clock at a 5-cycle latency; 1.86 sustained / 4.00 peak values/clock, 20.76x aggregate / 39.85x peak over a documented scalar baseline; 268 blocks / 67171 values / 138438 checked decodes, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_crc_feed_integrity_engine
projects.microarchitecture: combinational GF(2) CRC-32 fold (unrolled LFSR) + AXI4-Stream framing FSM + per-channel sequence RAM
projects.interface: AXI4-Stream packet ingress + AXI4-Lite control/status register file with an integrity-failure interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C feed-handler driver, a bit-exact CRC/sequence golden model, and a documented scalar cost-model baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model (bit-exact), anchored to the published CRC32("123456789")=0xCBF43926 known-answer vector, each packet run under randomised ingress bubbles and again at full rate, plus a peak micro-benchmark and a malformed-frame error/IRQ test
projects.summary: GPU/FPGA-style line-rate market-data feed-integrity engine: a combinational GF(2) CRC-32/FCS fold checks four payload bytes per clock while an AXI4-Stream framing FSM and a per-channel sequence RAM verify the trailer CRC and detect dropped-packet gaps, raising a sticky integrity interrupt one packet at a time; 3.770 sustained / 3.992 peak bytes/clock, 2-cycle result latency, 31.02x aggregate / 31.98x peak over a documented scalar baseline; KAT-anchored (0xCBF43926), 315 packets / 27838 bytes checked per pass under randomised ingress bubbles + full rate, 37 CRC errors + 30 sequence gaps caught, 632 records checked, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_pretrade_risk_engine
projects.microarchitecture: parallel heterogeneous risk-gate array with priority-encoded verdict reduction, a single-cycle position read-modify-write RAM, and a per-account accepted-order counter
projects.interface: AXI4-Stream order ingress + AXI4-Stream decision egress over an APB3 control/status register file with a violation/kill-switch interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C firmware driver, a bit-exact golden reference, and a documented scalar cost-model baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model (bit-exact), each stream run under randomised ingress bubbles + egress backpressure and again at full rate, plus an all-accept RMW burst, an APB statistics-histogram check, and a kill-switch/IRQ directed test
projects.summary: GPU/FPGA line-rate pre-trade risk / market-access gateway (SEC 15c3-5 style): every 128-bit AXI4-Stream order runs six heterogeneous risk gates (kill, range, halt, fat-finger price band, max order size, max notional, position limit, per-account message cap) fully in parallel, a priority encoder collapses them to a single accept/reason verdict, and an accepted order commits its new net position + count the same cycle via write-before-read forwarding; sustained 0.9936 / peak 0.9981 orders/clock at a deterministic 2-cycle latency; 53.39x aggregate / 53.63x peak over a documented scalar cost-model baseline; anchored to a pinned fat-finger reject, every reason code exercised, 312 orders/pass checked bit-exact under randomised bubbles + backpressure and at full rate, a 1024-order same-key RMW burst, an APB stats-histogram match, and a kill-switch/interrupt test, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_moe_router_engine
projects.microarchitecture: streaming fixed-point MoE-gating datapath: a log-depth top-2 argmax reduction tree feeding a piecewise-linear exp-LUT softmax renormalizer (two 34-stage pipelined restoring dividers) with per-expert capacity single-cycle read-modify-write counters
projects.interface: AXI4-Stream logit ingress + AXI4-Stream dispatch egress + AXI4-Lite control/status register file with an over-capacity interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, a bit-exact fixed-point golden model + shared exp LUT, and a documented scalar cost-model baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model (bit-exact), each stream run under randomised ingress bubbles + egress backpressure and again at full rate, plus CSR statistics/IRQ checks and E=4/8/16 parameterization
projects.summary: GPU/heterogeneous-inference Mixture-of-Experts top-k routing/gating engine: per token it selects the top-2 experts via a log-depth argmax tree, evaluates a fixed-point softmax (257-entry piecewise-linear exp LUT) renormalised by two 34-stage pipelined restoring dividers, and applies per-expert capacity with a single-cycle load read-modify-write, emitting a 128-bit dispatch record every clock at a deterministic 38-cycle latency; 0.893 sustained / 1.000 peak tokens/clock; 116.94x aggregate / 131.00x peak over a documented scalar cost-model baseline; bit-exact over 316 tokens (12 directed corner cases incl. a capacity storm + 300 random) checked under randomised bubbles + backpressure and again at full rate, plus CSR statistics + over-capacity IRQ checks and E=4/8/16 parameterization, gate weights within 1.35e-4 of a double-precision softmax, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_allreduce_collective_engine
projects.microarchitecture: R-stage x P-lane systolic reduction array (input-skewed reduce-PE chain) fed by a descriptor-ring DMA with an R-way coalesced gather, a matching-depth write-delay scatter pipeline, and a single adv gate for lossless stalls
projects.interface: descriptor-ring DMA (R-way gather + P-wide scatter) over a wide shared-memory master + MMIO control/status register file with a done/error interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver (descriptor builder + launch/ISR), a bit-exact integer golden model, and a documented scalar cost-model baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model (bit-exact), each collective run under randomised memory wait states and again at full rate, plus a single-big-collective peak micro-benchmark, CSR statistics checks, a zero-length-descriptor error/IRQ test, and full differential sim at R=2/4/8 parameter sets
projects.summary: GPU multi-GPU all-reduce collective engine (ncclAllReduce primitive): reduces R rank buffers of int32 element-wise with SUM/PROD/MAX/MIN and scatters the result, driven by a host-built descriptor ring; an R-stage x P-lane systolic reduction array (rank r skewed r cycles) retires P reduced elements/clock after an R-cycle fill, fed by a wide R-way coalesced gather and a depth-R masked-scatter write pipeline, all frozen losslessly by one adv=mem_ready gate; 2.87 sustained / 3.97 peak words/clock (P=4 roofline), 4-cycle latency, 51.65x aggregate / 71.44x peak over a documented scalar cost-model baseline; bit-exact over 49 collectives / 3627 elements / 924 groups per pass under randomised memory wait states and at full rate, incl. a 32-bit-wrapping SUM, PROD, signed MAX/MIN, single-element tail masks and a 2048-element peak collective, CSR statistics + zero-length-descriptor error IRQ checks, and full differential sim at R=2/4/8, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_ann_search_engine
projects.domain: vector search / approximate-nearest-neighbour retrieval (RAG / embedding inference)
projects.microarchitecture: P-lane SIMD int8 distance datapath (per-dimension (q-x)^2 / q*x lanes + combinational adder tree + int32 accumulator folding D/P beats per vector) feeding a streaming insertion-select top-K network (K sorted slots, parallel-compare insertion position, one candidate/clock) with a single advance gate for lossless ingress-bubble stalls
projects.interface: AXI4-Stream database-vector ingress (P int8 elements/beat, tlast per shard) + MMIO control/status register file with query window, top-K score/id readback, cumulative statistics, and a search-complete/error interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver (query load + launch/ISR), a bit-exact integer golden model for both L2 and inner-product top-K, and a documented scalar cost-model baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model (bit-exact score AND id), every search run under randomised ingress bubbles and again at full rate, plus a 2048-vector peak micro-benchmark, CSR statistics checks, a truncated-shard error/IRQ test, and full differential sim at D/P/K = 64/8/8, 32/4/4, 128/16/16, 256/16/8
projects.summary: GPU/heterogeneous-inference vector-search (ANN) top-K engine - the retrieval primitive behind RAG and embedding search (FAISS-GPU style, sharded multi-GPU): a query is loaded once, a database shard streams in over AXI4-Stream at P int8 elements/clock, P SIMD distance lanes score each vector (squared-L2 nearest OR inner-product highest) via an adder tree + int32 accumulator folding D/P beats into one score, and a streaming insertion-select network keeps the running top-K (K sorted slots, parallel-compare insertion, stable tie rule) at one candidate/clock. All integer, bit-exact vs a C golden model (score and id); 7.993 sustained / 8.000 peak dims/clock (P=8 roofline), 1-cycle fill/drain latency; 21.80x aggregate / 25.00x peak over a documented scalar cost-model baseline; 49 searches / 7364 vectors / 58912 beats per pass (9 directed corner cases - single vector, exactly-K, fewer-than-K, planted zero-distance hit, all-identical ties, IP argmax, IP ties, int8 saturation extremes - plus 40 randomised) checked bit-exact under randomised ingress bubbles and again at full rate, 762 result entries/pass, plus CSR statistics, a truncated-shard error/IRQ directed test, and full differential sim at D/P/K = 64/8/8, 32/4/4, 128/16/16, 256/16/8, 0 mismatches.
